claims.claim: Ps4 fat hacked with fc26 and 8 other games
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a dual-tone gaming controller on a display board; no PS4 console, no game discs/cases, and no readable labels/serials are shown.

risks.risk: The item may be only a controller (not a PS4 console bundle), so the seller’s “PS4 fat hacked + games” claim may not match what you receive.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the actual console (PS4 FAT) and the included game discs/cases (or storage media) laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller-only, worst-case as non-tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Controller may not work properly (button responsiveness, stick drift, vibration, triggers).
risks.proof: A power-on test clip showing the controller connected and all buttons/sticks responding (including vibration/trigger input if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until proven.

risks.risk: Brand/model and compatibility (PS4 vs Xbox vs PC/mobile) are not readable, so it may not be usable with your device.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of any brand/model text, port area, and pairing/label stickers (including any “PS4” markings).

risks.risk: Connectivity and accessories may be missing (wired vs wireless, Bluetooth/receiver, charging cable, battery).
risks.proof: Photos of the full package contents: cable/adapter/receiver/battery label, plus a shot of the controller’s charging/port area.

risks.risk: Physical condition may be worse than it appears (scratches, cracks, worn grips, missing caps/buttons).
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of both analog sticks, D-pad, face buttons, shoulder/trigger areas, and the back/ports.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the exact item(s) you will deliver: confirm whether it is only the controller or includes a PS4 FAT console.
If claiming PS4 FAT + games: provide photos of the PS4 FAT console (front/back/serial label) and all included games (discs/cases) laid out.
Provide a working test video: controller connected to the correct device, showing button presses and both analog sticks moving without drift.
Provide close-ups of any brand/model/compatibility markings and the controller’s port/charging area.
Show all included accessories (charging cable, receiver/dongle if wireless, battery info) in one photo.
response.reason: The witness report is sufficient to identify the item type as a dual-analog gaming controller, but not enough to verify the seller’s PS4/hacked-games claim. Price the controller at worst-case (untested/unknown compatibility) until the missing proof is provided.
